operating_points.notes: Manufacturer rated/recommended point. 37.5 kg / 8 g/W implies ~4687.5 W first-order, close to the published 4640 W rated input; do not use this arithmetic as a replacement for the full thrust table.
Derived power is thrust/efficiency arithmetic from manufacturer rated point; not a measured intermediate curve point.
Coaxial propulsion reference. Derived power is first-order thrust/efficiency arithmetic, not a manufacturer current point.

Q150.reason: 37.5 kg recommended axis load corresponds to 150 kg total at four axes; candidate class directly brackets heavy agricultural quad architecture.

H175.reason: 175/6 = 29.2 kg hover per axis, below A16 rated 35-40 kg; useful upper-envelope candidate but exact efficiency/current point requires manufacturer curve extraction.

COAX_HEAVY.reason: Manufacturer explicitly positions this propulsion class for 180-200 kg quad and 270-300 kg hex takeoff weight classes.

rules: No phase-current value is inferred from DC current.
No product rotor count or MTOW is frozen by this file.
Derived thrust/efficiency power values are CALCULATED_FIRST_ORDER and remain distinct from measured manufacturer table rows.
Final ESC envelope requires selected vehicle architecture and exact operating-point data.
